name: Exeter Parks & Recreation Summer Camps
operator_name: Town of Exeter Parks and Recreation
description_short: The Town of Exeter Parks and Recreation Department runs a Summer Adventure Camp for students entering grades 1–7, a Teen Summer Adventure Camp for grades 8 and 9, and a Summer Golf Camp. Campers are grouped by their grade as of 9/30/2026.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Summer Camps | Town of Exeter New Hampshire Official Website

warnings: This page only lists the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is posted yet.
This is a summary page for three separate programs: Summer Adventure Camp, Teen Summer Adventure Camp and Golf Camp. Details are on the 'Read more' pages, which were not part of the source.
The three session entries are program names only. The page gives no camp dates, weeks or prices.
Card payments carry a 3% processing fee, charged as a separate transaction.

Registration has priority windows. For the teen camp, returning resident campers and siblings could register Feb 2–8, 2026, and other residents Feb 9–13, 2026. The page gives no date for non-residents.
